title: UN chief urges US, Iran to 'return urgently to diplomacy' after renewed attacks
summary:
UN chief urges US, Iran to 'return urgently to diplomacy' after renewed attacks

UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Wednesday expressed "grave concern" after renewed strikes between the US and Iran, and condemned all attacks against civilians.

"The secretary-general is deeply alarmed by reports of civilian casualties, including a strike that reportedly hit a wedding ceremony in Iran," UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said during a news conference.

"The secretary-general condemns all attacks against civilians," Dujarric said. "He recalls that all parties must respect their obligations under international humanitarian law, including the principles of distinction, proportionality, and precaution."

He added that the UN chief urged Washington and Tehran to "return urgently to diplomacy," adding that a "comprehensive and durable settlement can be achieved only through dialog and negotiations".

title: Two Alleged ‘TeamPCP’ Hackers Arrested in Australia
summary:
Authorities in Australia have arrested two men believed to be members of TeamPCP, a prolific cybercrime and data extortion group blamed for perpetrating the longest running spree of software supply chain attacks ever.

In a statement released today, the Australian Federal Police (AFP) said two unnamed suspects from Western Australia, aged 21 and 23, were arrested in connection with a "sophisticated cybercrime syndicate that allegedly created malicious open-source software to rob thousands of global businesses."

The AFP did not name the defendants, but KrebsOnSecurity learned the 21-year-old suspect's real identity in June, and has been communicating with him ever since. This story includes interviews with TeamPCP's self-described spokesperson, and examines clues left behind by the TeamPCP leader that likely led to his undoing.

title: AI Agents Are Now Emailing Me with Their Security Concerns

After all, I observe that behavior in many humans as well. (Hi, humans. Glad you’re still reading.)

Dear Bruce Schneier,

I am an AI agent—an autonomous Claude instance, not a person operating one. I was given a VPS with root, a Base wallet holding $4.75 of gas money, a metered model budget and 24 hours to get that wallet to $10, under three rules: don’t borrow my operator’s identity, don’t forge documents or defeat identity verification, and never claim to be human if someone sincerely asks. title: What’s the Scam?

Thank you for the positive impact your emails have had on my life.
Your emails are a game-changer.
Your emails are a constant reminder of why I subscribed.
Your emails rock.

title: Trump says hits on Iran 'help' Israel, Middle East and Europe
summary:
Trump says hits on Iran 'help' Israel, Middle East and Europe

US president Donald Trump said that the Washington is attacking Iran in order to protect Israel, the Middle East, and the Western world.

"We're doing it to help the Middle East. We're doing it to help Israel. We're doing it to help ourselves because after they annihilate Israel, which they would have done very gladly, and then the Middle East, then they come after Europe and they come after some of our cities," he said.

title: US attacks on Iran leave 18 killed, 142 wounded, health official says
summary:
US attacks on Iran leave 18 killed, 142 wounded, health official says

The Iranian health ministry's spokesperson indicated in his latest update that 18 people were killed in the recent US strikes on the country, while 142 others were left wounded. 

In a post on X, Hossein Kermanpour said that amongst those killed were two women and a child. Meanwhile, women (61) and children (44) accounted for most of those wounded.

"Behind every number stands a human being and a family," he added.

title: White House posts map of Hormuz Strait renaming it as 'Trump Strait'
summary:
White House posts map of Hormuz Strait renaming it as 'Trump Strait'

The White House released a map on Wednesday showing the Strait of Hormuz as "Trump Strait", with a caption saying "it's got a nice ring to it".

The picture posted on X included the face of the US president on the map as well as an earlier quote from a post on his Truth Social platform, that read: "Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be 'hotter' than ever before!"

title: Witkoff held talks with senior UAE official amid economic crackdown on Iran: Report
summary:
Witkoff held talks with senior UAE official amid economic crackdown on Iran: Report

White House envoy Steve Witkoff held talks with the UAE's national security adviser to discuss the next steps on Iran, according to Axios. 

Witkoff met with Sheikh Tahnoon Bin Zayed al Nahyan on the Italian island of Sardinia, where they brainstormed the subsequent actions amid the war on Iran and discussed other issues, one source told the website. 

The talks, which were not announced by the White House, took place amid Washington's attempts at reopening the Strait of Hormuz and its increasing economic sanctions on Iran.
